statement: The C. elegans-trained parameter-context model will show stronger standardized transfer to the phylogenetically closer C. briggsae than to Drosophila.
support_condition: Both informative and directional ordering holds.
falsification_condition: Both informative and directional ordering fails.
blocked_condition: Either component transfer test is blocked.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before C. briggsae sequence acquisition and before Drosophila sequence acquisition.
